purpose: Paired exploratory screen of all five structure-feature candidates; MAG/PHA baseline and original C reference

integral.edge_distance: trapezoid of full normalized 3D squared link distance
integral.normalization: fixed target window span, never path point count

selection.primary: MAG_plus_alpha_PHA over final retained population, no auxiliary score
selection.secondary: common original max Frechet score within paired baseline MAG/PHA allowance

success_scope: Independent amplitude events, local phase progress and full phase events, global MAG/PHA, other events and costs. Four seeds and all five targets used in development; no generalization claim. Individual auxiliary targets, no combined seven-objective search.
cpu_policy: 32 allocated CPUs; BLAS threads 1 per worker; measure cgroup CPU consumption during useful computation; do not launch dummy work to inflate utilization; tail and IO may use less CPU
budget_policy: No post-result tuning, extra seeds or website upload; fixed definitions, hashes, paired initializations, operators and budgets; final population rules do not guarantee globally optimal parameters

family.aggregation: equal event/active angular block/bridge pair/TV segment mean; no post-result tuning
family.bridge_frequency_width: minimum width of the two fixed target events
family.bridge_block_measure: three equal positive blocks separated by 3dB core crossings; if overlapping, two equal blocks split at center midpoint
family.radius_floor: target window scale times 1e-12 with absolute floor 1e-15 ohm
family.feature_grid: fixed target grids in training; 257/513/1025 plus target and candidate anchors in independent audit; finite resolution limitation explicitly retained
family.angular_blocks: nonoverlapping selected amplitude windows and intervening gaps; activate if target total angle variation >=10 degrees
family.tv_partition: all target amplitude extrema and actual phase derivative zero crossings inside full focus span
family.curve_phase: passive positive-real impedance angle; increments on frozen training grid, no candidate reorientation

scheduling: longest predicted tasks first; target base timings from completed previous batch and new auxiliary preflight timings; prediction frozen before optimization
